generatedProse.practice-connection: In the School of Sport, reflection is the habit the school runs on, whatever your subject. Every lab report a sport scientist reviews, every session a coach looks back on, every participation campaign a management student weighs, every treatment a therapist reconsiders, draws on the same skill. The methods differ across the school, but the honest look-back is shared. Treat what follows as being about your own sport work, that is, your reports, practicals, placements and sessions, not about study in the abstract.
